## August 27 Archival Enrichment (Increment 216)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American and British radio, three generations of young prodigies on *The Quiz Kids* for Alka-Seltzer (1941 literature/ornithology, 1944 Joel Kupperman wartime geography, 1950 Hiawatha & astronomy), *The Comic Weekly Man* reading the Sunday funny papers for *Puck*, and two historic Anglo-American documentary collaborations on *Transatlantic Call* (Coventry reconstruction and Burl Ives singing the "Song of America") (1941–1950):
